## Before filing

**Do not report a suspected vulnerability, credential exposure, customer-data exposure, or data-boundary failure in this form.** Use the private process in [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md) instead. Do not include sensitive prompts, tokens, customer information, or production secrets in an issue.

## Summary

Provide a concise description of the unexpected behavior and its user or operator impact.
